title: Refuse a clean source envelope whose full source_id contains local changes
outcome: The source-command adapter consistently rejects an internally incoherent clean envelope with root or submodule changes, preserving producer-owned judgment and whole-object identity semantics.
acceptance: After producer-owner agreement on envelope coherence, status clean with nonempty root changes or any submodule changes is unavailable; coherent clean and not_clean measurements keep the agreed full value without local Git judgment.
Focused parser coverage independently discriminates root and child incoherence, with coherent positive controls; no source_id projection, fallback or consumer policy change is introduced.
